summary: Replaced the past-epoch skip in ingest() with the MIP-03 rollback decision tree. Added isBetterCandidate and isReplayOfApplied to src/core/group-message.ts, the RollbackInfo type and #rollbackToEpoch() private method to marmot-group.ts, and two new skipped reasons (self-echo-commit, lost-race). All acceptance criteria covered by 17 new tests.

reviews.codex: ran — P1 (delayed delivery limitation = S4 scope, not a bug); P2 (Prettier format) fixed

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The rollback scenario requires both competing commits to arrive in the same ingest() batch for decryption to succeed (both encrypted with epoch-N exporter_secret). This architectural boundary between S2 (same-batch rollback) and S4 (past-epoch decryption window) was implicit in the spec but only became fully clear when designing the rollback test. The AC-ROLL-5 test for 'both delivery orderings' was simplified to same-batch permutations because cross-batch delivery is an S4 concern.

absorbed_from.note: P1: rollback only works within same ingest batch; delayed cross-epoch delivery is S4 scope. P2: Prettier format issue on convergence-property.test.ts — fixed.

lead_clarifications.question: AC-ROLL-1 cross-decryptability assertion was missing (examiner PARTIAL, sev 5)
lead_clarifications.answer: Lead added a faithful cross-decrypt round-trip: admin winner sends an application message, rolled-back member decrypts it via real ingest path. Test passes; all 471 green.
